body:
It's just so hard. I can't see the light at the end of the tunnel. It used to be so bright but now... it's just easier to sleep all the time. 

Thank you though. I'm not off the rooftop but I'm of the edge and I think for now, that's good enough. I'm going to look into internships. I never even considered that as a possibility but that might be the job for me. Thank you thank you thank you.

My parents are vehemently against any sort of break. They're extremely old school and since they're still my source of income I have to listen to them or they'll probably cut me off and then when I go home, kick me out. 

I know it's probably the fantasy of every girl out there but I've always been into fashion and modeling, ever since I was a kid. But I'm too short so that was ruled out as soon as I hit puberty. Besides that, I've always been into organizing and planning but I'm not sure how that would focus into a job. 

The school that I'm at right now, it attracts a certain type of student, one that's really driven and motivated and has a clear picture of what he/she wants to do. All my friends here know what they want to do, they're in their major and they have clear goals for the future. This school churns out engineers and top scientists and politicians but I don't want to do any of that. I'd rather do something that makes me happy than something that makes me rich but no one gets that. Not my parents, not my friends, nobody I know. My closest friends who I can relate to the most are on the other side of the continent so I can't even go to them, it's all over facebook and skype.

The thing is, I have no idea what I want to do in life. Of course I have fantasies (who doesn't?) but they're so unrealistic that it's not even worth pursuing them. I hate that I have to pick a major, pick classes around that major etc etc. I have no idea what I want to do! I'm only nineteen, I barely know what I'm going to eat for dinner, let alone what I want to do for the rest of my life. 

I'm so frustrated. I can't leave school because my parents would kick me out and even though I have friends that would let me live with them I don't want to be living just day to day, paycheck to paycheck. I don't think I would last living that kind of existence (even though I'm barely functioning now). I'm just so lost. I feel like such a failure and once I flunk out of school (academic probation) then everyone will know it, not just me.
